findings.issue: Two wrong readings: 父上 is read ちちうえ, not ちちじょう; and 何 before を is read なに (なん occurs only before だ/の/で/と/counters), so なんを is wrong.
findings.current: ちちじょう、なんをしておられるのか。
findings.suggested: ちちうえ、なにをしておられるのか。

findings.issue: The honorific suffix 上 in 父上 is read うえ (ちちうえ), never じょう in this word.
何 directly before the object particle を is read なに; なん is used only before だ/の/で/と or counters.
Romaji reproduces the wrong readings from kana ('chichijou' for 父上, 'nano' for なんを); should reflect ちちうえ / なにを.

運転 in 車の運転 means 'driving/operating (a vehicle)'. The en gloss 'direction / guidance' is a back-translation of pt 'direção' and is not a sense of 運転; the parallel sentence 84472 correctly glosses it 'driving, operating'.
The literal field must mirror 私を医者にする = 'make me (into) a doctor'; 'for me (object) to become a doctor' renders にする as if it were になる and diverges from lit_pt, which correctly uses 'transformar'.
findings.current: My father (topic) shows the wish for me (object) to become a doctor.
findings.suggested: My father (topic) shows-the-wish-to make me (object) into a doctor.

findings.issue: Conjugation note derives したがって from したがう (a different verb, 従う 'to obey'); the base verb is したがる, so the derivation is したがる→したがって. Same one-kana slip in both the pt-BR and en note versions.
findings.current: forma 〜て de したがる (したがう→したがって); したがる é o desiderativo de terceira pessoa de する + がる
findings.suggested: forma 〜て de したがる (したがる→したがって); したがる é o desiderativo de terceira pessoa de する + がる

findings.issue: Token list begins with stray duplicated tokens 木曜 + 日 before 父, so the tokens reconstruct 木曜日父は…; 木曜日 already appears correctly later in the list. Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1].
findings.current: 木曜 (tokens[0]) + 日 (tokens[1]) prepended before 父
findings.suggested: (delete tokens[0] and tokens[1]; sentence tokens start at 父)

findings.issue: 何も in this neutral-polite sentence (何もしません) is read なにも; なんも is a colloquial/dialectal contraction and wrong as the standard transcription.
findings.current: ちちわいえでわなんもしません。
findings.suggested: ちちわいえでわなにもしません。

findings.issue: 何 in 何も is read なに (なにも), not なん.
Romaji 'nanmo' reproduces the wrong kana reading of 何も; should be 'nanimo'.
